blurb: Guests can rent houseboats, pontoons, runabouts, fishing boats, Wave Runners, and kayaks to explore Smith Mountain Lake. Rentals include a full orientation and safety briefing. Flexible booking options include 3-day weekends, 4-day weekdays, or full 7-day adventures.
